findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key appended as a query parameter (?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX).
findings.actual: Query parameter api_key is rejected with HTTP 401 ('send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'). It must be passed in the X-API-Key header.
findings.how_found: Probed /health and /v1/listings with query parameter and received 401 error instructing to use X-API-Key header.
findings.impact: Any frontend or client adhering strictly to the documentation fails to authenticate every request.

findings.documented: Returns token and expires_in: 86400 (24 hours). Documentation claims tokens are valid for 24 hours with no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns access_token (not 'token'), refresh_token, and expires_in: 900 (15 minutes). An active refresh flow exists via POST /auth/refresh.
findings.how_found: Inspected JSON payload from POST /auth/login and tested POST /auth/refresh successfully.
findings.impact: User sessions silently expire and fail after 15 minutes unless the client uses /auth/refresh to renew tokens.

findings.documented: Documentation lists user session Bearer token only under user actions, implying public endpoints only require the API key.
findings.actual: Requests to /v1/listings, /v1/rentals, and /v1/projects fail with 401 ('missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first') without Authorization: Bearer <token>.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request with only X-API-Key header and received 401 requiring a logged-in user token.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated browsing of property collections is blocked entirely.

findings.documented: Collection endpoints take page (1-indexed) and limit (max 200). Response returns page, page_size, total, and results.
findings.actual: The API uses limit and offset. The 'page' parameter is quietly ignored. Maximum limit is capped at 50, and response metadata includes limit, offset, count, total, and has_more.
findings.how_found: Passed page=2 with limit=5 and verified offset remained 0 and results did not advance. Tested limit=200 and server clamped limit to 50.
findings.impact: Clients implementing page-based pagination will stay stuck on the first 50 results.

findings.documented: total is the exact number of records matching your filters. To fetch every record, read total, divide by limit, and request that many pages.
findings.actual: The total field reports 4315, but continuing pagination until has_more is false yields 4700 retrievable records. The reported total undercounts.
findings.how_found: Paged past offset 4315 up to offset 4650, retrieving records until has_more returned false at record 4700.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side, so anything this endpoint returns is safe to show to a user.
findings.actual: The endpoint returns inactive listings with is_live: false (978 inactive records out of 4700 total).
findings.how_found: Inspected the is_live boolean property across all 4700 retrievable listings; 3722 are live and 978 are inactive.
findings.impact: Without client-side filtering on is_live, inactive and off-market properties are displayed to end users.

findings.documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: For all 389 listings sourced from 'magichomes' with carpet_area < 300, both carpet_area and super_built_up_area are recorded in square meters instead of square feet.
findings.how_found: Identified that exactly the 389 listings with carpet area < 300 originated from website 'magichomes' (e.g. 75 to 154 sq m for 2-4 BHK units, corresponding to 800-1650 sq ft).
findings.impact: Calculations of price-per-sqft are inflated by ~10.76x unless converted.

findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API. price_min and price_max are in rupees.
findings.actual: In project records, price_min and price_max are floating-point numbers in Crores (Cr) INR (e.g. 1.04 to 99.8 Cr), not integer rupees.
findings.how_found: Inspected price_min and price_max values across all 520 project records and found values like 1.04, 38.9, and 99.8.
findings.impact: Displaying project prices directly without multiplying by 10,000,000 shows prices in single digits rather than Crores.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing object.
findings.actual: GET /v1/listing/{id} returns 404 Not Found. The working endpoint is pluralized: GET /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.impact: Detail view links following documentation fail to load property records.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found; this endpoint was never deployed.
findings.how_found: Invoked GET /v1/listings/{id}/similar for multiple valid listing IDs, all returned 404.
findings.impact: Recommendations strip on listing detail views cannot rely on a dedicated server endpoint.

findings.documented: User favourites managed at GET /v1/favourites, POST /v1/favourites with {'id': '...'}, and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id}.
findings.actual: All /v1/favourites routes return 404 Not Found. The live service operates at /v1/saved, where POST requires {'listing_id': '...'} and DELETE uses /v1/saved/{id}.
findings.how_found: Probed candidate paths; /v1/favourites was 404 while /v1/saved returned 200 OK and accepted {'listing_id': '...'}.
findings.impact: Attempting to save favourites according to documentation fails with 404 errors.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary provides pre-computed aggregate market statistics (median price, locality/BHK breakdown).
findings.actual: Returns 404 Not Found; the analytics summary endpoint does not exist on the server.
findings.how_found: Queried /v1/analytics/summary and related variations, all returning 404.
findings.impact: Analytics dashboard cannot fetch pre-computed metrics and must aggregate data on the client side.

findings.documented: Query parameters include min_price, max_price, furnishing, and project_id.
findings.actual: Parameters min_price, max_price, furnishing, and project_id are accepted by the server without error but are completely ignored in filter evaluation.
findings.how_found: Requested listings with min_price=10000000, furnishing=semi-furnished, and project_id=P10001; total remained 4315 and results were unchanged.
findings.impact: The client application must implement client-side filtering for price ranges, furnishing types, and project association.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listing records across different aggregator websites describe the exact same physical apartment unit (matching building, floor, bedroom count, and coordinates with slight broker text/pricing variations). Across 4700 listings, only ~4381 distinct physical properties are represented.
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by (apartment_name, locality, bedroom, floor, total_floors, facing_direction, property_type) and identified 310 multi-listing groups totaling 629 duplicate records.
findings.impact: Inventory counts are inflated unless listings are deduplicated to physical properties.

findings.documented: Listings represent physically viable real estate properties.
findings.actual: Exactly 40 listing records contain physically impossible attributes: 8 have floor > total_floors, 8 have carpet_area > super_built_up_area, 8 residential properties have bedroom=0 and bathroom=0, 8 have swapped latitude/longitude coordinates (>77N, <14E), and 8 have negative prices.
findings.how_found: Ran systematic validation checks across all fields of 4700 listings; each anomaly type has exactly 8 records.
findings.impact: Showing corrupted records degrades user trust and crashes naive UI layout calculations.

findings.documented: Listings are genuine properties offered for sale.
findings.actual: Exactly 8 listings feature monthly rental rates (6,250 to 16,790 INR) masquerading as full property purchase prices to bait user enquiries.
findings.how_found: Analyzed price distribution: exactly 8 listings have prices under 20,000 INR (e.g. 6,720 INR for a 2BHK in Indiranagar) while genuine sales start above 19 Lakhs.
findings.impact: Misleads prospective buyers searching for sale properties.

findings.documented: total_listings is the number of listings currently available in the project and always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: The reported total_listings value disagrees with active (is_live: true) listings for 127 projects out of 520, and GET /v1/listings?project_id=... quietly ignores the project_id parameter.
findings.how_found: Compared each project's reported total_listings against actual live listing counts linked to its project_id; 393 match perfectly while 127 are desynchronized.
findings.impact: Project cards display inconsistent listing availability numbers.

findings.documented: Timestamps: ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: The /health endpoint returns server_time carrying an explicit +05:30 offset (Asia/Kolkata timezone) rather than UTC with a 'Z' suffix.
findings.impact: Date parsing libraries expecting UTC 'Z' suffixes encounter unexpected timezone offsets.
